m_shoulder_cars: standing upright side-on to the camera with the right arm straight down by the side, left hand on the hip, side view
slowly draws one very large controlled circle with the straight right arm: forward, overhead, behind and back down to the side
m_overhead_lat: standing with feet hip-width, right arm reaching overhead, left hand holding the right wrist, torso leaning to the left in a side bend, front view
holds the standing side-bend lat stretch, breathing slowly
m_back_scratch: standing upright, right elbow pointing to the ceiling with the right hand between the shoulder blades, left hand gently holding the right elbow, front view
holds the overhead triceps stretch calmly, breathing slowly
m_wrist_stretch: kneeling on all fours on a grey exercise mat, palms flat on the mat with the fingers pointing back toward the knees, arms straight, side view
gently leans the hips back toward the heels to stretch the forearms, then returns
m_cat_cow: kneeling on all fours on a grey exercise mat with a flat neutral back, hands under shoulders and knees under hips, side view
slowly arches the back and lifts the gaze, then slowly rounds the back up toward the ceiling tucking the chin, and returns to the flat back
m_thread_needle: kneeling on all fours on a grey exercise mat, left hand on the mat, right arm reaching straight up to the ceiling with the chest rotated open, front three-quarter view
slowly threads the right arm under the body until the right shoulder rests on the mat, then rotates back and reaches the right arm up to the ceiling again
m_open_book: lying on her left side on a grey exercise mat facing the camera, knees bent at 90 degrees and stacked on top of each other, both arms extended straight forward on the floor with the palms together, head resting on the mat, eye-level side view from the front, camera horizontal

slowly lifts the top arm and opens it in a wide arc over the body until it rests on the floor behind her, rotating the chest toward the ceiling while the knees stay together, then slowly closes it back
m_puppy: kneeling on a grey exercise mat with the hips directly above the knees, arms stretched far forward on the mat, chest and forehead lowered toward the mat, side view
holds the puppy pose calmly, chest sinking, breathing slowly
m_seated_twist: sitting upright on a grey exercise mat, left leg straight, right knee bent with the right foot placed outside the left knee, torso twisted to the right, left elbow against the right knee, right hand on the mat behind, front view
holds the seated spinal twist tall, breathing slowly
m_cobra: lying face down on a grey exercise mat in a low cobra: hands under the shoulders, chest lifted, hips and legs on the mat, shoulders down, side view
holds the low cobra calmly, breathing slowly
m_knees_to_chest: lying on her back on a grey exercise mat hugging both knees to the chest with both hands, head resting on the mat, side view
holds the knees-to-chest position and rocks very gently
m_supine_twist: lying on her back on a grey exercise mat, arms spread out to the sides in a T shape, the right knee bent and dropped across the body to her left side resting toward the floor, the left leg straight, both shoulders flat on the mat, eye-level side view, camera horizontal
holds the lying spinal twist calmly, breathing slowly
m_pelvic_tilt: lying on her back on a grey exercise mat with knees bent and feet flat on the mat, arms relaxed at the sides, side view
slowly flattens the lower back into the mat by tilting the pelvis, then slightly arches the lower back, a small slow pelvic movement
m_happy_baby: lying on her back on a grey exercise mat in the happy baby pose: knees bent wide toward the armpits, hands holding the outer edges of the feet, soles facing the ceiling, front view
holds the happy baby pose calmly
m_side_bend: standing with feet slightly apart, left hand on the hip, right arm reaching overhead, torso bending to the left, front view
holds the standing side bend, breathing slowly
m_couch: in a couch stretch next to a plain wall: right knee on a folded mat against the wall with the right shin up the wall, left foot forward in a lunge, torso upright, hands on the left knee, side view
holds the couch stretch with an upright torso, breathing slowly
m_lizard: in a deep low lunge on a grey exercise mat: left foot forward, right knee on the mat, both hands on the mat inside the left foot, hips sinking low, side view
holds the lizard lunge stretch, hips sinking gently
m_worlds_greatest: in a deep lunge on a grey exercise mat: left foot forward, right leg straight back, right hand on the mat inside the left foot, left arm reaching straight up to the ceiling with the chest rotated open, front three-quarter view
slowly lowers the raised arm down toward the mat inside the front foot, then rotates the chest open and reaches the arm up to the ceiling again
m_figure4: lying on her back on a grey exercise mat in a figure-four stretch: right ankle crossed over the left knee, both hands pulling the left thigh toward the chest, head on the mat, side view
holds the lying figure-four glute stretch calmly
m_pigeon: in a pigeon pose on a grey exercise mat: right leg bent in front with the shin across, left leg straight back, hips square, torso upright with fingertips on the mat, side view
holds the pigeon pose calmly, breathing slowly
m_9090: sitting on the floor on a grey exercise mat with the buttocks on the mat: the front leg lies flat on the mat bent at 90 degrees in front of the body, the other leg lies flat on the mat bent at 90 degrees out to the side and behind, both knees and both shins resting on the mat, torso upright, fingertips resting lightly on the mat, front three-quarter view
sits tall in the 90/90 hip stretch and leans the chest slightly forward over the front shin, then returns upright
m_9090_switch: sitting on a grey exercise mat in a 90/90 position with both knees pointing to the right, hands on the mat behind the hips for support, front view
slowly lifts both knees and rotates them over to the left side into the mirrored 90/90 position, then rotates back to the right
m_hip_cars: kneeling on all fours on a grey exercise mat with a flat back, hands under the shoulders, the right knee bent and lifted out to the side at hip height like a fire-hydrant exercise, the left knee on the mat, view from behind at a slight angle
slowly moves the lifted bent right leg in a large controlled circle: knee forward toward the elbow, out to the side, and back behind, keeping the back and hips still
m_hip_circles: standing with feet shoulder-width apart, hands on the hips, front view

keeps the feet planted, hands on the hips, chest and face toward the camera; slowly sways the hips in a wide circle: to the right, back, to the left and forward, like a slow dance warm-up. Empty hands, no hoop, no props, no objects appear
m_deep_squat: sitting in a deep resting squat, heels flat on the floor, elbows pressing the knees outward with palms together in front of the chest, chest lifted, front view
holds the deep squat calmly, gently shifting weight from side to side
m_butterfly: sitting on a grey exercise mat in a butterfly stretch: soles of the feet together, knees dropped out to the sides, hands holding the feet, back long, front view
holds the butterfly stretch, leaning slightly forward from the hips
m_frog: in a frog stretch on a grey exercise mat: resting on the forearms and on both knees, the knees spread very wide apart out to the sides with the inner thighs facing the floor, shins and feet pointing outward, hips low and in line with the knees, back flat, front view
holds the frog stretch calmly and gently rocks the hips slightly backward and forward
m_side_lunge: standing in a very wide stance in a side lunge: right knee bent with weight on the right leg, left leg straight with the heel on the floor, hands together in front of the chest, front view

keeps both feet planted in the wide stance; slowly bends the right knee deeply and shifts the hips far over the right foot while the left leg stays straight, then slowly shifts across to bend the left knee deeply while the right leg straightens, and returns
m_forward_fold: standing forward fold: feet hip-width, torso folded down from the hips, arms and head hanging heavy toward the floor, knees slightly soft, side view
holds the standing forward fold, relaxing a little deeper with each breath
m_down_dog: in a downward-facing dog on a grey exercise mat: hands and feet on the mat, hips high, body in an inverted V shape, arms and back in one long line, side view
holds the downward dog, gently pedalling the heels toward the mat
m_active_ham: lying on her back on a grey exercise mat, left leg straight on the mat, right leg lifted straight up toward the ceiling, arms relaxed at the sides, side view
slowly lowers the straight right leg down to the mat, then lifts it straight up again as high as possible
m_calf_wall: standing facing a plain wall with both hands on it, left foot forward with the knee bent, right leg straight back with the heel on the floor, leaning forward, side view
holds the standing calf stretch against the wall
m_knee_to_wall: in a half-kneeling position facing a plain wall: left foot flat on the floor a short distance from the wall, right knee on a mat, hands on the wall, side view
slowly drives the left knee forward over the toes until it touches the wall keeping the heel down, then returns
m_ankle_circles: standing on the left leg with the right foot lifted slightly off the floor in front, one hand resting on a chair back for balance, side view
slowly draws large circles with the toes of the lifted right foot, only the ankle moving
m_breathing: lying on her back on a grey exercise mat with knees bent and feet on the mat, one hand on the belly and one hand on the chest, eyes closed, side view
breathes slowly and deeply, the belly rising and falling
outdoor_run: running on the red track, mid-stride with one foot off the ground, relaxed shoulders, arms bent at 90 degrees, side view
runs at a steady relaxed pace with good running form while the camera tracks alongside at the same speed, the runner staying centered in the frame
h_squat_jump: standing in a deep bodyweight squat with thighs parallel to the floor, arms swung back, side view
performs one squat jump: explodes straight up off the floor with the arms swinging up, lands softly and sinks back into the squat
h_jump_lunge: in a deep lunge position with the left foot forward and the right knee just above the floor, torso upright, side view
performs jumping lunges: jumps up and switches legs in the air, landing softly in a lunge with the other foot forward, then switches back
h_reverse_lunge: standing upright with feet hip-width apart and hands on the hips, side view
performs one reverse lunge: steps one foot far back and lowers until the back knee almost touches the floor, then pushes back up to standing
h_wall_sit: in a wall sit against a plain wall: back flat on the wall, thighs parallel to the floor, knees at 90 degrees, arms crossed over the chest, side view
holds the wall sit steadily, breathing
h_skater: balancing on the right leg in a low athletic stance with the left leg crossed behind and the left hand reaching toward the floor, front view
performs skater jumps: leaps sideways to land softly on the left leg with the right leg crossing behind, then leaps back to the right
h_butt_kicks: jogging in place with one heel kicked up toward the glutes, arms bent, side view
runs in place kicking the heels up to the glutes at a quick light rhythm
h_fast_feet: standing in a low athletic stance with knees bent, on the balls of the feet, arms bent, front view
runs in place with very fast short steps staying low, feet barely leaving the floor
h_step_jack: standing with the right foot stepped out to the side and both arms raised overhead, front view
performs low-impact step jacks without jumping: steps the foot back to the centre lowering the arms, then steps the other foot out to the side raising the arms overhead
h_march: standing tall with the right knee lifted to hip height and the left arm bent forward, side view
marches briskly in place lifting the knees to hip height one after the other with the opposite arm swinging
h_plank_jack: in a high plank position with straight arms and feet together, side view from a slight front angle
performs plank jacks: jumps both feet out wide and back together while holding the plank, hips staying level
h_plank_tap: in a high plank position with straight arms and feet slightly apart, front three-quarter view
lifts one hand to tap the opposite shoulder, places it back, then taps with the other hand, hips staying still
h_bicycle: lying on her back on a mat with hands behind the head, shoulders lifted, the right knee pulled in and the left leg extended just above the floor, side view
performs bicycle crunches slowly: rotates the torso bringing the elbow toward the opposite knee while the other leg extends, then switches sides
h_russian_twist: sitting on a mat with knees bent and heels on the floor, torso leaning back slightly with a long back, hands clasped in front of the chest, front view
rotates the torso to touch the hands to the floor beside one hip, then rotates to the other side
